ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white background (approximately 65-70%) contrasted with high-density, low-intensity black/grey pixels (approximately 30-35%) concentrated at the periphery and peduncle attachment.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Heavy black contiguous mottling along the entire trailing edge and lateral tips. Dense vertical black clusters at the central hinge. High-contrast black streaks and speckling distributed across the mid-lobe white fields, with a higher density of speckling on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an approximate pixel angle of 38 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 12% of the fluke's total vertical span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, medium-amplitude serrations present along the outer lateral edges. Irregular scalloping and jagged peaks observed on the inner trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature following the trailing edge leading to elongated, pointed lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, circular low-intensity ring-like structures visible on the right lobe white field. High-intensity white focal points (potential barnacle scars) scattered near the notch vertex.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant horizontal and diagonal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the left lobe. Distinctive dark vertical and diagonal linear streaks crossing the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple parallel linear rake marks across both lobes; irregular jaggedness on the trailing edge indicating minor historical tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly distinct, isolated dark circular 'O' shaped mark located in the mid-inner region of the right lobe.
